	internal class Range : Stingray.Grid.Range
	{

		{
			createFrom(range);
		}

		public unsafe Range(CGXRange* range)
		{
			createFrom(range);
		}

		private unsafe void createFrom(CGXRange* range)
		{
			switch (*(int*)range)
			{
			default:
				rangeType = RangeType.rtCells;
				break;
			case 3:
				rangeType = RangeType.rtTable;
				break;
			case 2:
				rangeType = RangeType.rtCols;
				break;
			case 1:
				rangeType = RangeType.rtRows;
				break;
			}
			top = ((int*)range)[1];
			left = ((int*)range)[2];
			bottom = ((int*)range)[3];
			right = ((int*)range)[4];
			bValid = _cast._bool(((int*)range)[5]);
		}
	}

					2 => MergeCellsMode.EvalOnDisplay,

		}

		[return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.U1)]
		public virtual bool HideRange(Range ogr, [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.U1)] bool bHide)
		{
			bool result = true;
			validateRange(ogr);
			switch (ogr.RangeType)
			{
			case RangeType.rtRows:
				result = HideRows(ogr.Top, ogr.Bottom, bHide);
				break;
			case RangeType.rtCols:
				result = HideCols(ogr.Left, ogr.Right, bHide);
				break;
			case RangeType.rtTable:
				if (HideRows(0, RowCount, bHide))
				{
					if (HideCols(0, ColCount, bHide))
					{
						result = true;
						break;
					}
					OnUndo();
					result = false;
				}
				break;
			case RangeType.rtCells:
				if (HideRows(ogr.Top, ogr.Bottom, bHide))
				{
					if (HideCols(ogr.Left, ogr.Right, bHide))
					{
						return true;
					}
					OnUndo();
					result = false;
				}
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

	internal class GridPreviewPrintController : PreviewPrintController
	{
		private GridPreviewPrintDocument doc;

		public GridPreviewPrintController(GridPreviewPrintDocument pDoc)
		{
			doc = pDoc;
		}

		public override void OnStartPrint(PrintDocument document, PrintEventArgs e)
		{
			doc.Previewing = false;
			base.OnStartPrint(document, e);
		}

		public override void OnEndPrint(PrintDocument document, PrintEventArgs e)
		{
			doc.Previewing = true;
			base.OnEndPrint(document, e);
		}
